sections.changelog:
1.2.2

  • Added a House version limit of one saved room per language, including drafts, private rooms, and scheduled rooms.
  • Prevented duplicate rooms when creating, changing languages, or restoring from Trash, while allowing edits and translations into available languages.
  • Updated the top offers count to include enabled offers without a featured image.

Earlier changes

  • Added the accommodation booking form flow with booking storage, lead tracking, and customer and owner emails.
  • Added booking settings for email texts and owner email subjects.
  • Added room-specific offers, meal plans, multilingual support, and booking calendar enhancements.
sections.faq:
Can I use this plugin on any WordPress site?

No, this plugin is designed specifically for Patlis platform websites.

Does it support room bookings?

Yes, the plugin includes a built-in booking system for managing room reservations.

Can I manage multiple room types?

Yes, you can create and manage multiple room types with different prices and details.

Does it support availability management?

Yes, you can control availability and booking rules directly from the admin panel.

Is it suitable for hotels and apartments?

Yes, the plugin is designed for hotels, apartments, and other accommodation businesses.
